                           ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit

(Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 3-1 in

the area bounded by


       The alley next north of and parallel to West Iowa Street,
       North Rockwell Street; West Iowa Street; and a line 35.23
       feet west of and parallel to North Rockwell Street,


to those of a C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

14.   The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARC) requires on-site affordable housing units
